name: Server Sided Corpse
description: Fully server-side lootable corpses: when you die, your body stays where you fell — wearing your skin — holding your items and XP until you come back for it. Works with completely vanilla clients; nothing to install client-side. The corpse settles on the ground and floats on lava or water, right-click opens it as a chest, sneak-right-click takes everything back to its original slots. Owner-locked until it ages into public, and a forgotten body eventually drops its contents so nothing is ever truly lost.
